author: Simon's Cat
description:
This week, TV Dinner gets the 4K upgrade treatment. First released in summer 2008, it’s a fan favourite in the Simon’s Cat catalogue, with nearly 50 million views to date. Enjoy! 🎬

Every Friday, we’re releasing a classic film remastered in 4K and colour. At the end of each month, you can also watch a full compilation of that month’s episodes — ideal for the big screen!
